measured: Measured with `hyperfine --shell none --warmup 3` on an Apple M4 (4 performance cores), 164,000 files, 18,001 directories, 11G, warm cache. The default worker count is those 4 cores. `dush -t10` uses every logical core.
also: GNU coreutils 9.12 (`gdu -sh`) took 457.0 ms (453.2 … 466.9 ms) on that same tree. On the small bench fixture (16,410 files, 667 directories, 4.8M) dush took 8.0 ms, diskus 16.5 ms, and `du -sh` 23.3 ms.
